implementation.method: rebin/weights area-overlap, actual R37A; no production hook modification

baseline: Frozen original median of sideband centers outside line endpoints by 10 km/s. Identical fixed physical line support partitioned at literal endpoints. Compare signed baseline-subtracted normalized area, positive-excess centroid, peak, relative integral L1 shape error, original vs conservative reverse grid; no absolute flux calibration.
acceptance: All canaries must respond as expected; report each transform independently without threshold retuning. Derived profile can be marked REVIEW on violation; original immutable always. No classification, no automatic suppression, no line removal or production changes.
limitations: 715.2557 Hz scientific averaged spectra, not original 2.794Hz time-frequency data. Conditional LSRK, no spatial OFF, two sources in development not blind. This is R37A mathematical processing + new isolated preservation check, not end-to-end R28/HANNAH detector.
